{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The DIYMAG bar magnets connect directly to my recent magnetic hook purchases, so they feel relevant for removable mounting.",

  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The tap kit uses #10-24 threads, while my recent screws were metric; being another fastener tool does not make it useful for the same work.",
    "Wire connectors, testing leads, a thermal camera and a feeler gauge require specific tasks that my recent hardware purchases do not establish.",
    "Exam gloves, a COVID test and pipe couplings do not connect to my current mounting interests, and ten containers of glue exceed any immediate need I have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat buying hardware as a reason to want almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "The mention of electronics in my screw assortment seems to have been stretched into an interest in wiring and electrical testing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Two recent magnetic hook purchases suggest that practical hanging and removable mounting matter more to me right now than general tools.",
    "Compatibility and ready-to-use function matter: metric fasteners fit my recent purchases, and hooks serve a clearer purpose than bare magnets.",
    "I rarely choose something just because it might be useful someday; I need a clear current use, especially for large quantities."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my interest in magnetic mounting but stretched it into a much broader need for tools and supplies."
}
